messages:
elaine: Quick heads-up — just pushed the 'latency-squeeze' micro-deploy across prod GPU pools. Short summary: p50 down ~12%, p99 down ~25% on our Llama/Kv-heavy traces, and token unit cost down ~9% for typical chat workloads. Rolling out with conservative smoothing thresholds so no noisy spikes. :tada:

infra-bot: canary report (canary-42 -> prod):
- baseline p50: 86ms -> 75ms (-12.8%)
- baseline p99: 420ms -> 315ms (-25%)
- avg token cost: $0.0088 -> $0.0080 (-9.1%)
- errors: 0.02% -> 0.03% (within alert window)

sam: omg nice. what exactly changed? batching or kv policy? :eyes:

elaine: it's a small combo: opportunistic microbatcher now defers <8ms when it predicts a matching prefix will arrive (new prefetch hint), and the KV prefetcher uses a lightweight LRU shadow for hot prefixes so we avoid expensive remote fetches for short tails. Also tuned timebox to favor p50 without blowing up p99. No model code changes.

devon: any rollback flags if we see error uptick or latency regress? want to wire into release bot.

elaine: yes — rollout includes the feature-flag key `runtime.latency_squeeze` with per-pool override. rollback is `curl -X POST $RELEASE/api/flags/runtime.latency_squeeze/disable --data '{"pool":"<pool>"}'`. Runbook updated: https://go/redwood/runbooks/latency-squeeze (short link).

maria: Do Dedicated customers get this by default or opt-in? privacy/compat concerns?

elaine: Default ON for Hosted and Dedicated unless they set `runtime.disable_latency_optimizations=true` in their config. We documented the impact and opt-out steps in the runbook. No model compatibility changes, but we flagged a few edge cases for very long-context jobs — those can opt out.

luca: posting the quick healthcheck we used in canary — use this to sanity check pools:
```
# check p99 delta by pool
python tools/metrics_delta.py --metric p99_latency --from canary-42 --to prod --group pool
```

sam: love the numbers. can we get a short note for release notes / ops channel? one-line with metrics + opt-out link.

elaine: will do — drafting a short blurb for ops + customer-success. TL;DR will be: "Latency-squeeze deployed: p50 -12%, p99 -25%, token cost -9%. Opt-out via runtime.disable_latency_optimizations. See runbook." :thumbsup:

devon: adding to dashboards now. keep an eye on the 5-10m windows for any regressions.

infra-bot: deploy bot: feature `runtime.latency_squeeze` enabled on pools: gpu-us-west-1a, gpu-us-west-1b, gpu-eu-central-1a. Canary -> full in 18m.

elaine: thanks team — big kudos to the microbatcher + prefetch crew. will post a short writeup later with a few graphs. :party_parrot:
